rationale: Both use g-projected property/topic ratio with 0.30/0.15 cuts. A: topic shift from sample-label latents minus confound shifts, true-logit pairs on all probes, rank-by-contribution greedy, ablation check via probe_scores. B: keyword topic assignment on corpus, true logits only probe 1, ratio-maximizing greedy ranked by minimal-pair signatures, scoped regex, no ablation check.
